description: Change of use from retail unit (E use class) in to restaurant (E use class) incorporating the installation new shop front and an extraction flue system to rear of the premises
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (HGS102/22/01, HGS102/22/02, HGS102/22/03, HGS102/22/04, HGS102/22/05, HGS102/22/09, HGS102/22/11, HGS102/22/12, HGS102/22/13, Design Access Statement, Odour Management Plan, Noise Impact Assessment Received 28 June 2022;  HGS102/22/06, PLANNING FIRE SAFETY STRATEGY Received 25 July 2022; HGS102/22/08 Rev A, HGS102/22/10 Rev A Received 17 August 2022; HGS102/22/07 Rev A Received 18 August 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The replacement shopfront hereby approved shall be constructed with metal framed windows and white fascia sign and the external finish of the extraction flue shall be painted or wrapped to match the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The restaurant shall not be occupied until space has been laid out within the site in accordance with approved plan no. HGS102/22/07 Rev A for 2 bicycles to be parked and that space shall thereafter be kept available for the parking of bicycles; photographic evidence shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority upon completion as verification, prior to commencement of the use.

Condition : 5 - Prior to occupation, full details of the arrangements for the storing of waste and recycled materials, including details of screening from the public highway, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 6 - a) The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, shall be 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level, at all times that the mechanical system etc operates. The measured or calculated noise levels shall be determined at the boundary of the nearest ground floor noise sensitive premises or 1 meter from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance to the latest British Standard 4142; An alternative position for assessment /measurement may be used to allow ease of access, this must be shown on a map and noise propagation calculations detailed to show how the design criteria is achieved.
b) The plant shall be isolated on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to prevent the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjacent or adjoining premises, and these shall be so maintained thereafter.
c) Following installation of any mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, a post completion noise assessment shall be submitted for approval to the local planning authority which demonstrates the actual measured rating level of plant operating under normal conditions. All measurements shall be made in accordance with the methodology of BS4142: 2014 (Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound) and/or its subsequent amendments. The post completion report shall be both completed and submitted to the local authority within 28 days of completion of the installation for review.

Condition : 7 - The restaurant unit hereby approved shall not operate (including providing for the collection or delivery of takeaways), receive deliveries, have waste collected or undertake maintenance of the premises outside of the designated operating hours of 08:00 to 23:00 Monday to Sunday and on public holidays without the prior written permission of the Local Planning Authority. This requirement shall be permanently adhered to.

Condition : 8 - Notwithstanding the approved plans, the front door to the commercial unit shall have a minimum width of 1 metre with at least 0.3 metres of space to the pull side of the door between the leading edge and the internal wall and shall be retained as such for the lifetime of the development and the internal floor level will be kept level with the forecourt of the property.
